decisions.reason: The inertial measurement sensor module is close to the firm's established sensor and control know-how, so the firm can readily assimilate market feedback and improve the product.
The AC voltage input module builds directly on the firm's existing power and input modules and already has its own product page, indicating strong absorptive capacity and low drop risk.
The solid state relay module is close to the firm's established control and power switching products, enabling effective learning from early results and low drop probability.
The server room monitoring sensor kit builds on existing sensing and kit offerings, allowing the firm to leverage its related knowledge and keep the product.
